notes.notes:

notes.title: Dev Log - Apr 2025
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

Here is an update to show a little of what we've been up to.

[h2]FourCast Cutscene Sneak Peak:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116315/af93f386e06863cc1ae064407112a087b88b4679.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116315/9634b96ec773e24834355e89be746aede809108e.png[/img]
These are WIP images of a cutscene that takes place after escaping the town of FourCast. I wonder who that was flying in the distance? It seems that Buster saw it too and it's angered him... Hmm... 

[h2]Awesome Car:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116315/1e3611be7e9bf1572fd4f7ad09520f5ad45d560a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116315/daa83be1560adbcde34b2d164c70d5a333ba0888.png[/img]
This is a set of wheels you want to be spotted driving. You can be lactose intolerant and still drive this car. It even comes in multiple colours! 

[h2]2025 Release Date:[/h2]

This exciting story about a boy and his friend doing a whittle delivery is on track to come out in 2025. The team is enthusiastic about what we're making and the best is still yet to come.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3062450/The_Whittled_Horse/



Until next time,
Isaac

notes.title: Dev Log - Jan 2025
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

The team and I wanted to give an update on the games progress.

[h2]The town of FourCast:[/h2]
We're well into development of the second town of the game called FourCast. It is a spooky place and the inhabitants of the town aren't going to let Thomas and Evey pass through easily. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116315/e64c5084032433919380cd3d3edfeb378c6929f6.png[/img]

[h2]New and returning characters:[/h2]
There will be new characters in FourCast, such as the Engineer and the Preacher. Some characters you met in the first town will have their story continued, such as this disgruntled old man who was upset the boys working at the mill didn't care he used to work there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116315/adcb35cc6efeb804a1412452cfd2c49732640dc0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116315/37bad60d851848b2c6f15a302c4bc2c6a3f39030.png[/img]

[h2]High scope cutscene planned:[/h2]
We've also starting planning a higher scope cutscene that takes place in the third town of the game. Here are some concepts of the characters that will be in that cutscene:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116315/f622b1c7a199112a2f98afa4399e3f20f405ba79.png[/img]

[h2]Releasing in 2025:[/h2]
The game is still on track to release in 2025, we will let you know a more specific date as soon as we can.  Wishlist to stay updated on our progress!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3062450/The_Whittled_Horse/



Until next time,
Isaac

notes.title: Demo Available Now!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

The team and I have been working very hard and are proud to release a demo for The Whittled Horse!

In the demo you will experience the town of Newf. It is a peaceful place, with some odd and mysterious characters in it. You will also play the first biking section, an obstacle dodging mini-game that will act as a bridge between the towns you visit in the final game. And lastly, you will absorb dramatic cutscenes that set up the conflict for the remainder of the game.

If you play the demo and have any feedback, good or bad, please leave a review on the demo page or join our Discord and let us know!


The final game is set to launch in 2025, we have exciting things planned!

Until next time,
Isaac

notes.title: Introducing The Whittled Horse - A Charming Adventure Game
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I'm very excited to announce my team's new game The Whittled Horse! 


We have been working very hard and are looking forward to releasing a demo this October (2024). The final game will be released early 2025. 

There are a lot of amazing ideas and art in the pipeline for areas outside of what you'll see in the demo, and I can't wait to see how people react!


Please consider wishlisting to stay updated on news about the demo and the final game. Your support means the world to myself and the team.

Until next time,
Isaac
